notes.title: 🎮 Join Our 24-Hour Arena Demo Challenge! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're excited to announce a special event happening this Saturday! We'll be live streaming and playing our game, and we want you to join in on the fun by playing the arena demo alongside us. Here are the details:

🗓 Date: Saturday
⏰ Time: Starts at 18:00 GMT+3
⏱ Duration: 24 hours

How to Participate:

Play the Demo: During the event, play our game demo.
Record Your Gameplay: Start recording your screen when you press the "Arena" button at the beginning of the game and stop the recording when you defeat the final boss.
Share Your Video: Upload your gameplay video to the designated event section on our Discord server.
What's in it for you?

The three players who complete the game in the shortest time will receive a special reward: a Steam key to join us in testing the beta version of the game! You'll get an exclusive chance to play the full game early and share your feedback with us as we continue to develop it.

We're looking forward to seeing your amazing gameplay and hearing your thoughts. Let's make this a fun and memorable event for our community!

Happy gaming and good luck! 🍀

[url=https://discord.gg/xBrJ2ens?event=1240668065210040330][b]Our Discord[/b][/url]

notes.title: Update to the Combat Arena
notes.notes:
📢 [b]A Message From Us:[/b] We added a direct message from our Game Designer.

🎮 [b]Navigation Controls:[/b] No more confusion! We've created a comprehensive guide detailing all the navigation controls within the game. Navigate like a pro!

🏟️ [b]Arena Asset Organization:[/b] Say goodbye to clutter! We've reorganized the assets within the arenas for a smoother and more immersive gameplay experience.

🌊 [b]Updated Enemy Waves:[/b] Get ready for more action! We've revamped the enemy waves, adding new challenges and adjusting quantities for an adrenaline-pumping experience.

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've squashed those pesky bugs! From minor glitches to unexpected hiccups, our team has been hard at work ensuring a smoother gaming experience for all players.

🎨 [b]Visual Refresh:[/b] Immerse yourself in a refreshed world! We've updated the colors, tones, and in-game assets to enhance the overall visual appeal and make every moment in Fix Fixer even more captivating.

Dive back in now and experience these exciting updates firsthand! Your feedback drives our progress.

notes.title: Exciting News: We're in the Prelaunch Phase of Our Campaign!
notes.notes:
🌟 Exciting News! 🌟
Hello, everyone! We are thrilled to share a big announcement from our team at Triant Games. Our latest project, Fix Fixer, has officially launched on Kickstarter and we are excited to have you all on this journey with us!

🎮 Why Kickstarter?
Kickstarter allows us to build Fix Fixer with direct feedback from you, our community. Your support and suggestions are crucial for us to develop a game that resonates with tech enthusiasts and gamers alike. We want this game to be a community-driven project from the very start!

🤝 Join the Adventure:
By backing Fix Fixer on Kickstarter, not only are you helping to bring this game to life, but you are also gaining access to exclusive rewards and the chance to influence the game’s development process. This is your opportunity to leave your mark on Fix Fixer!

🙏 Thank You:
We can’t express enough how much your support means to us. Every comment, share, and pledge takes us one step closer to bringing Fix Fixer into reality. Thank you for being such an integral part of Triant Games and for continuing to inspire and drive us forward.

Let’s make Fix Fixer a remarkable journey together! Visit our Kickstarter page today to learn more about the game and how you can contribute. Stay tuned for regular updates and behind-the-scenes looks at how your contributions are making a difference!
